gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.

gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.
